arena.tip1: Sing your heart out, but leave room for the person next to you — not everyone matches your volume.
arena.tip2: If you record, keep your phone at eye level, not in front of someone else's view.
arena.tip3: Leave early if you can — mass exits plus traffic beat missing the last train.

teatro.tip1: In an acoustic room, one yell at the wrong moment echoes — save the hype for the choruses.
teatro.tip2: Flash off, always — the artist and your neighbor will thank you.
teatro.tip3: Arrive with buffer time — lines, coats, and merch take longer than you'd think.

festival.tip1: Hydrate and eat something — the sun doesn't negotiate.
festival.tip2: Pick a meetup spot with your crew in case signal drops.
festival.tip3: Respect the space of people who got there first — it's not a tent, but the line still counts.

generic.tip1: Enjoy first, document later — a few good clips beat filming the whole show vertically.
generic.tip2: Someone going solo isn't your involuntary audience — ask before recording up close.
generic.tip3: Save your ticket or entry pass before leaving home — venue WiFi isn't always reliable.
